fails_if: the register loader keys its one-owner-per-edition check by split target instead of by native variant, so two splits of variant 1.2 into different variants may both take edition '2007'
note: Harder than identity-edition-split-edition-assigned-twice-refused: the two entries split into different variants. The allowed twin, the same two splits with disjoint editions, is the build case edition-split-disjoint-splits-share-one-native-variant.
